interface.longDescription: DropMind helps e-commerce sellers research winning products, explore short-form video ads, calculate unit economics and break-even ROAS, browse and personalize dropshipping prompts, retrieve marketing playbooks, and audit public online stores across six conversion categories. Guest mode supports up to 10 products per search without sign-in. Prompt hydration clearly labels assumed default values when no live product ID is supplied. Creating Shopify product drafts requires a connected DropMind account and store.
defaultPrompt: Find pet products with at least $20 profit per unit.
Calculate break-even ROAS for a $39.99 product costing $9.50 plus $4 shipping.
